$comment: libniimblue API spec: the single source of the generated binding methods (see api/generate.mjs, README 'Adding a method').
Every method is a JS bridge method (js/bridge.ts `methods`) reached through niim_call_bin. `npm run gen` writes the
typed wrappers for Go, Rust, Python, Swift and Kotlin; `npm run gen:check` verifies them and the bridge method list.
method: JS method name. name: API name (camelCase); Go Pascal, Rust/Python snake, Swift/Kotlin camel; names: per-language overrides
(a lowercase Go name keeps the method unexported, for a hand-written wrapper on top). doc: one sentence or more.
const: fixed params object entries. params: in order, required before optional; type int|bool|string|json|bytes or
<Record>[], '?' = optional. json = raw JSON value (Go json.RawMessage, other bindings JSON text, Python any JSON-able
value or JSON text). bytes = the binary payload. A record list sends its bytes field as offset/length slices of the
payload. go = Go param type override (e.g. an options struct pointer).
result: void|bool|int|string|json|<Type>|<Type>[]; Go decodes into the type (from types below or hand-written in go/),
Rust/Swift/Kotlin return bool/int natively and JSON text otherwise, Python parsed JSON (bytes fields decoded).
skip: languages that keep a hand-written version. internal: bridge methods only reached through their own C function.
types: Go structs (go/zz_api_types.go); record: true also generates the type in every binding (method params).

methods.name: connectVirtual
methods.doc: Connect to a simulated printer driven by a request/response hex dump (testing).

methods.name: connectPng
methods.doc: Connect to the PNG printer: the test print. Jobs run the real queue, print task and packets and each page becomes a PNG of the final tag as the printer puts it on paper (see pngPages). Options: {"model":"B1","labelWidth","labelHeight","printheadPixels","printDirection","protocolVersion"}.

methods.name: print
methods.doc: Print an image: pixels row-major, top-left first, format from options ("rgba" default, "rgb", "gray"). Options as niim_print in include/niimblue.h; {"wait":false} returns the job snapshot right away.

methods.name: printBatch
methods.doc: Print several different images as one print job (one print task; the job prints the sum of the page quantities). Returns {"printTask","pages","jobId","images":[{"cols","rows","quantity"}]}.

methods.name: submit
methods.doc: Queue a print job (printBatch) and return its snapshot right away; wait for it with waitJob.

methods.name: renderTemplate
methods.doc: Render a .niim template package without a printer (the design, not a test print). Returns {"width","height","printDirection","format":"rgba","pixels":"<base64 RGBA>"}.

methods.name: printTemplate
methods.doc: Print a .niim template package as one queued job; data is one object of tag values or an array of objects (one label each). Options: threshold, strict, quantity, density, labelType, printTask, wait, label, ...

methods.name: isConnected
methods.doc: Whether a printer is connected.

methods.name: printerInfo
methods.doc: Printer info fetched during connect (see fetchPrinterInfo to refresh it).

methods.name: fetchPrinterInfo
methods.doc: Fetch the printer info from the printer again.

methods.name: modelMetadata
methods.doc: Metadata of the detected printer model (null when unknown).

methods.name: printTaskType
methods.doc: Print task detected for the printer, e.g. "B1" (null when unknown).

methods.name: heartbeat
methods.doc: Fetch the printer status (battery, lid, paper).

methods.name: lastHeartbeat
methods.doc: Printer status of the last heartbeat (no printer request).

methods.name: rfidInfo
methods.doc: Fetch the RFID info of the inserted label roll.

methods.name: lastRfidInfo
methods.doc: RFID info of the last fetch (no printer request).

methods.name: startHeartbeat
methods.doc: Start the periodic heartbeat.

methods.name: stopHeartbeat
methods.doc: Stop the periodic heartbeat.

methods.name: setHeartbeatInterval
methods.doc: Heartbeat interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: setPacketInterval
methods.doc: Delay between packets sent to the printer, in milliseconds.

methods.name: setDebug
methods.doc: Log protocol details ("log" events).

methods.name: setVerboseEvents
methods.doc: Also emit packet level events.

methods.name: setSoundEnabled
methods.doc: Turn a printer sound on or off. type: "BluetoothConnectionSound" or "PowerSound".

methods.name: setAutoShutdownTime
methods.doc: Auto shutdown time: "ShutdownTime1" (usually 15 min) to "ShutdownTime4".

methods.name: models
methods.doc: All printer models known to niimbluelib.

methods.name: printTasks
methods.doc: Names of the print tasks (printTask option).

methods.name: registerFont
methods.doc: Register a TrueType / OpenType font (TTF or OTF bytes, not WOFF) for template text under a CSS family name. weight 100..900 (default 400). Missing bold / italic faces are synthesized; registering the same face again replaces it.

methods.name: fonts
methods.doc: Fonts available for template text.

methods.name: templateTags
methods.doc: Tag names a .niim template package uses, e.g. ["sku","url"].

methods.name: pngPages
methods.doc: Pages printed by the PNG printer (niim_connect_png), all or of one job (last 200 pages).

methods.name: clearPngPages
methods.doc: Forget the PNG printer pages, returns how many there were.

methods.name: job
methods.doc: Snapshot of a print job (active or one of the last ~100 finished).

methods.name: jobs
methods.doc: Active jobs and the last ~100 finished ones (oldest first).

methods.name: cancelJob
methods.doc: Cancel a queued job. A job that is printing can't be cancelled.

methods.name: clearQueue
methods.doc: Cancel every queued job, returns how many were cancelled.

methods.name: waitJob
methods.doc: Wait until the job finished. Fails with the job error if it failed or was cancelled.

methods.name: pauseQueue
methods.doc: The printing job finishes, no new job starts until resumeQueue.

methods.name: resumeQueue
methods.doc: Start queued jobs again.

methods.name: queuePaused
methods.doc: Whether the queue is paused.

Job.doc: Job is a snapshot of a print job.

fields.name: pages
fields.doc: Pages is the number of different images (or template labels), TotalPages includes copies.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.doc: Unix times in milliseconds (0 = not yet).

fields.name: result
fields.doc: Result of a done job: PrintResult or TemplatePrintResult JSON.

JobEvent.doc: JobEvent is the payload of "jobdone" events ("jobqueued" and "jobstarted" carry a Job).

PageResult.doc: PageResult describes one printed image of a batch.

PNGPage.doc: PNGPage is one label printed by the PNG printer: the final tag as the printer puts it on paper.

fields.name: copies
fields.doc: copies the printer was told to print

fields.name: width
fields.doc: label size in dots, reading orientation

fields.name: png
fields.doc: PNG file of the final tag.

FontInfo.doc: FontInfo describes a font registered for template text.

fields.name: pixels
fields.doc: width x height pixels, row-major (format in options)

fields.name: options
fields.doc: Page options overriding the job options: {"format","stride","quantity","threshold","printDirection"}.
